name: ROLLER RING | Stable Multi-mount Parametric Filament Spool Holder

captions.detailed: This 3D model is a parametric filament spool roller base. It features a flat, circular ring structure as its foundation, with four curved slot cutouts arrayed around a central circular hole. Mounted on the perimeter are four low-profile bearing holders designed to cradle the edges of a filament spool. Two tall, upright retainer arms extend vertically from opposite sides of the ring, each featuring a slotted hole at the top and a stabilizing gusset rib at the base to prevent the spool from tipping.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric, ring-shaped 3D printer filament spool roller stand in OpenSCAD. The design must include adjustable parameters for spool diameter, spool width, and bearing dimensions, featuring a circular ring base with optional cutouts, four perimeter bearing mounts, and two tall vertical side retainers with slotted holes to prevent spool dislodgement.
captions.factory: The design is constructed using a flat ring base defined by a difference of concentric 2D circles, extruded linearly. Curved slots are subtracted using a loop of rotated circle sector differences. Four bearing mounts are placed at 90-degree intervals on the ring perimeter, each composed of a union of horizontal cylinders and vertical support tabs with bolt holes subtracted. Two tall retainer arms are modeled with flat upright polygons, reinforced by triangular gussets, and placed diametrically opposite each other with slotted holes subtracted near their rounded tops.
